name: @confeature/dagger-call
description: The one way a local `pnpm dagger:*` script hands the repository to Dagger (#789): a gitignore-filtered snapshot of the working tree, the ceiling, signal forwarding and cleanup. Also the tests that keep the Dagger engine pinned (#865): every CI dagger-for-github step derives its version from dagger/dagger.json and installs a CLI verified against dagger/cli-checksums.txt, and scripts/dagger-precheck.sh holds the local CLI to that exact version.
author: MakerLabs
